verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes provides isolated, VM-based execution environments for running untrusted code, and outbound HTTP can be intercepted by Workers, so agents can test away from production systems. But the docs never frame this as protecting production data, and bindings to KV/R2/Durable Objects mean isolation from real data depends on how the user configures it. The community-reported all-or-nothing outbound network control further limits guarantees. missing for 10: documented production-data separation (test/staging data or seeded fixtures), fine-grained outbound egress controls, independent hands-on corroboration of isolation from production resources.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The Sandbox SDK enables you to run untrusted code securely in isolated environments.
VM-based isolation - Each sandbox runs in its own VM
Each sandbox runs in its own isolated container with a full Linux environment, providing strong security boundaries while maintaining performance.
Intercept and handle outbound HTTP from sandboxes using Workers.
